# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We aim to be kind, direct, and constructive. This project is a place for technical discussion and collaboration. We expect participants to be respectful and professional.

## Standards

Good behavior includes:

- Using welcoming and inclusive language
- Being respectful of differing viewpoints
- Accepting constructive feedback gracefully
- Focusing on what is best for the project

Unacceptable behavior includes:

- Harassment, threats, or personal attacks
- Discriminatory or exclusionary remarks
- Spammy or disruptive behavior
- Publishing others' private information without permission

## Scope

This applies to all project venues, including GitHub issues, pull requests, discussions, and any other communication related to the project.

## Enforcement

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, please report it by opening a private security/contact issue where available, or by emailing the maintainers if a contact path exists. All reports will be reviewed and handled with discretion. Maintainers may remove contributions or restrict participation when needed to keep the project healthy.

## Attribution

This code of conduct is adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.5.
